capabilities: Two-way sync JokeBakery jokes, sprints, lists and gigs as Markdown files
Create new sprints, jokes and lists by adding notes in the sync folder
Write up gigs with ratings, laugh types and per-joke notes
Preserve losing sides of sync conflicts in a Conflicts folder
Hold back mass deletions behind a confirmation prompt
extras: The JokeBakery account is currently invite-only. Installation is via the BRAT plugin or manual file copy. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The plugin is developed in the JokeBakery app repo and mirrored to this release repo.
problem: JokeBakery material lives in a hosted app and cannot be read, edited, searched or linked from Obsidian without manual copying.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a companion to the hosted JokeBakery service
0.4.0 changed the plugin id from bakerwriter-sync to jokebakery-sync

summary: Two-way sync that mirrors JokeBakery jokes, sprints, lists and gig write-ups into a vault folder as editable Markdown files.
